title: The ZPA Terraform provider: where its behavior is described

prose.text: This walks the subjects that describe what the ZPA Terraform provider sends, reads and reports. Which API paths and SDK packages each resource uses, and its arguments (type, required or optional, computed, ForceNew, defaults, enum values and validators, nested blocks), are generated from the provider code: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <resource name>`; `provider:zpa` gives the provider's own settings.

prose.label: Configuring the provider.
prose.text: Credentials, clouds and rate limits are in [[zpa.terraform.provider-config]].

prose.label: Policy rules.
prose.text: The v1 and v2 rule resources and their conditions are in [[zpa.terraform.policy-rule-resources]], what a rule write sends and loses in [[zpa.terraform.policy-rule-writes]], and how `rule_order` is applied in [[zpa.terraform.rule-order]].

prose.label: What reaches the API.
prose.text: Per-resource constraints are in [[zpa.terraform.resource-constraints]]. Fields not sent, not read back or written in several steps are in [[zpa.terraform.resource-fidelity]], application segments and their associations in [[zpa.terraform.app-segment-lifecycle]], enrollment certificate lookup for groups in [[zpa.terraform.group-enrollment]], and deletes with dependents in [[zpa.terraform.delete-paths]]. Data sources are in [[zpa.terraform.data-source-selection]] and [[zpa.terraform.data-source-fidelity]].
